name: Cross-sectional momentum rotation (14d, top/bottom 8, dollar-neutral)
one_line: Rank 47 perps by 14d return, long top 8 / short bottom 8, rebalance every 3 days; BTC 14d<-10% -> cash.

source.license: no LICENSE file in repo; owner's own repository (owner-provided reference, do not redistribute)

markets: Binance USD-M perpetuals (paper only in source)
status_in_source: adopted (running as paper test in owner's repo)
idea: Relative-strength rotation: momentum = close[t]/close[t-14]-1; hold equal-weight longs in top K and shorts in bottom K; rebalance every 3 days; optional crash filter: if BTC 14-day return < -10%, move to cash.
rationale: Cross-sectional momentum persists in crypto; dollar-neutral construction removes market beta.
evidence: 0.04% fee, no funding: CAGR 28.9%, MDD 18.6%. With 0.10% fee + funding, phase-averaged: 17.8-20% (source's own correction). IS 27.0 -> OOS 41.3 (genuine split). Sharpe 95% CI [0.07, 1.64]. Crash filter improved 10/10 combos but threshold was chosen with full-sample diagnostics.
limitations: overlays (vol target, regime switch, 5,953 alpha variants) overfit: IS best -> OOS collapse

pipeline_fit.notes: Only the BTC crash-to-cash filter (14d return < -10% -> flat) is reusable as a single-asset risk overlay.
